evidence.notes: Search.find with WITH SNIPPET exposes deterministic local snippets for fixed search result rows.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLSOSLWithSnippetTest { @isTest static void searchFindReturnsFieldSnippet() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Snippet Account'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{ account.Id }); Search.SearchResults found = Search.find('FIND {Snippet} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name) WITH SNIPPET'); List<Search.SearchResult> accounts = found.get('Account'); System.assertEquals(1, accounts.size()); System.assertEquals(account.Id, accounts[0].getSObject().Id); System.assertEquals('Snippet Account', accounts[0].getSnippet('Name')); System.assertEquals('Snippet Account', accounts[0].getSnippet()); } }
